/* saleson.shop.orderagency.OrderAgencyMapper.selectAgencyLoginConfirmInfo 대행주문 로그인 정보 조회 */
SELECT USER_SESSION_ID , VALID_ACCESS_CD , PRIVATE_KEY , MANAGER_ID , CRYPTO_DEC('normal', CNTRBTR_MOBILE, '', 0) AS CNTRBTR_MOBILE , CNTRBTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT FROM G_AGENCY_LOGIN_CONFIRM_INFO WHERE 1=1 AND USER_SESSION_ID = #{userSessionId} AND VALID_ACCESS_CD = #{validAccessCd}

/* saleson.shop.orderagency.OrderAgencyMapper.selectOrderAgencyManagerInfo 대행주문 관리자 조회 */ SELECT LOCGOV_NM , PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_NM , CRYPTO_DEC('normal', USER_NAME, '', 0) AS USER_NAME , PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_ID FROM ( SELECT M.LOCGOV_CODE , L.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM || ' ' || L.LOCGOV_NM AS LOCGOV_NM , CASE WHEN UR.AUTHORITY = 'ROLE_ADMIN_11' THEN LPWCM.PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_NM ELSE R.ROLE_NAME END AS PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_NM , CASE WHEN UR.AUTHORITY = 'ROLE_ADMIN_11' THEN LPWCM.PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_ID ELSE 0 END AS PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_ID , M.USER_NAME FROM OP_MANAGER M JOIN OP_USER_ROLE UR ON M.USER_ID = UR.USER_ID AND UR.AUTHORITY LIKE 'ROLE_ADMIN_%' AND UR.AUTHORITY != 'ROLE_ADMIN_CALL' LEFT JOIN G_LOCGOV L ON M.LOCGOV_CODE = L.LOCGOV_CODE LEFT JOIN G_LCLGV_PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_MNG LPWCM ON M.BANK_CODE = LPWCM.PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_ID LEFT JOIN OP_ROLE R ON UR.AUTHORITY = R.AUTHORITY WHERE 1=1 AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.STATUS_CODE = '9' )
